heroHeadline: China Tech Stocks Hit All-Time Record High; ByteDance Doubao Powers 7M Vehicles as Auto China 2026 Closes with Record 1.28M Visitors
heroSubtitle: China's benchmark technology stock index surged to an all-time record high on May 6, 2026 (Bloomberg), as financial markets deliver a historic verdict: the domestic AI ecosystem built under US export controls is now valued more highly than at any point in China's tech history. ByteDance's Doubao AI model is embedded in 7 million vehicles across 145 models and 50+ brands, as China's EV price war transforms into an AI features arms race (CNBC, May 2). Auto China 2026 closed on May 4 with a record 1.28 million visitors and 181 world-debut vehicles — the largest automotive exhibition in history — confirming China's transition from mass-volume EV manufacturer to full intelligent mobility ecosystem leader. CNBC reported on May 6 that SenseTime, operating under US entity list sanctions, is winning global enterprise AI market share through cost-efficient models and Middle East expansion — illustrating how sanctioned Chinese AI companies are systematically capturing markets US firms cannot serve at comparable price points. Structural picture as of May 6: Huawei commands ~60% of China's domestic AI chip market ($12B revenue forecast, +60% YoY); China's NDRC has blocked foreign AI acquisitions (Meta's $2B Manus bid); the domestic AI compute market expands at 136% annually; Premier Li Qiang has officially declared China's open-source AI models as leading the global ecosystem; and every dimension of US-China tech decoupling — compute, models, capital flows, and corporate ownership — is now structurally separated. The record high in Chinese tech stocks is the market's pricing of this structural shift.
